title: Command card (M13, 91 A). Names are the real ones; every text is our own words.

cost.description: Army points, paid from the list total (CC7). The five universal cards cost 0.

fa.description: Field allowance, for cards that have one.

armies.description: Army ids that may take the card (a list's `army`). Empty = universal: every faction and army.

timing.description: activationAny: any time during the activation of one of your models or units; activationStart: at the start of that activation; maintenanceStart: at the start of your Maintenance Phase (91 A.5).

subject.description: What the card is played on: the activating model or unit, a single model, or the activating warrior model or unit.

options.description: The choices when the card is played (most cards print two). `code` names the engine effect in src/engine/cards.ts.
